name: Opus Picks-and-Shovels
strategy: Long diversified AI-infra suppliers (power + semi-cap + custom silicon) with a contained 15% 3x-semis leverage kicker and a small laggard short; leverage capped so the April-dip-style drawdown stays ~-14%, not -44%.

positions.thesis: 3x semis kicker sized so a -50% dip = -7.5% NAV; buying into the -29% one-month correction with H2 AI-capex cycle intact
Grid/power buildout for datacenters; best 1M momentum (+12%) of the book
Semi-cap equipment, steady leader (+126% YTD); shallow -18% dip drawdown, lower-beta anchor
Datacenter power/cooling; stabilized after correcting, core electrification shovel
Custom-silicon connectivity, highest-beta compounder (+111% YTD); sized small given -47% dip risk
Electrical connectors/power management, resilient, diversifies the power sleeve
AI datacenter networking; positive 1M momentum, lower-beta big-cap ballast
Commoditized AI-server assembler lagging the theme, thin margins; small hedge on a relative loser

backtest.notes: SOXL decay check: daily compounding HELPED in the H1 uptrend (+294% actual vs +254% naive) but drove -43.5% peak-to-trough in the Feb-Mar dip. Capping SOXL at 15% cut basket drawdown to -14%. HONEST: in-sample basket of known H1 winners; short-term momentum has rolled over; a sideways H2 bleeds SOXL.

outlook: AI-infra capex stays the dominant H2 tailwind; leaning into power/electrification that is holding up while memory/optics cool. Expect choppy re-acceleration, not a straight-line repeat.
